goals.name: Build a camp
goals.description: The wind takes everything. Grow a windbreak, then light a fire in its shelter.

goals.name: Catch a spark
goals.description: Hold the field recorder up to a lightning bug and collect its square wave.

goals.name: Build a heartbeat
goals.description: Patch both cables so the burbler sounds on every beat.

goals.name: Cut reeds
goals.description: Gather twelve reeds for a stream.

goals.name: Water the tree
goals.description: Lead the burbler's stream to a scrub oak.

goals.name: Stop the wind
goals.description: Keep the water flowing until the oak buds and breaks the wind.
